name: onebrain-agent-template
description: A chat agent with your team's One Brain: its skills, knowledge and memories, and each chat sent back so One Brain learns from it.

ONEBRAIN_API_KEY.description: A One Brain agent key (`ob_...`): make one in the One Brain app under **Agents**, or with `onebrain admin keys create <agent>`. The agent reads and writes what the key may.

ONEBRAIN_URL.description: Your One Brain API. Keep `https://api.useonebrain.com` unless you run One Brain yourself.

AGENT_TOKEN.description: Anyone with this token can chat with the agent, and through it reach your One Brain. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ONEBRAIN_FOLDER.description: Optional. The One Brain folder for the agent's memories and captured chats, such as `agents/assistant`. A workspace agent key needs one, unless your workspace has a capture folder. Empty: a key that acts for a person keeps memories private to them.

AI.description: Workers AI, for the default model.

Assistant.description: The agent: one Durable Object per chat, holding its messages.
